phone.university: Soha, the assistant of Shahid Beheshti University
phone.identifyBody: Enter the number. If it is stored on an account, even an unverified one, you sign in with that number’s password. If it is not attached to any account, only a new account can be created.
phone.legacyLead: Phone registration does not attach an older email account to this number.
phone.passwordBody: This number is already stored. Enter its password. If it is not verified yet, a correct password starts SMS activation for that same account.
phone.activationBody: The password was correct. Enter the SMS code for this existing account. This step does not create a new account.
phone.activationRestart: Activation failed and its token was used up. Start sign-in again with this number and password.
phone.registerOtpBody: This number is not attached to any account. The owner may still have an older email account. Requesting a code only creates a new account.
phone.registerCodeBody: The send request was accepted. That does not mean the SMS reached the phone.
phone.registerBody: Enter the name, role, and password for the new account. Email is optional and stays unverified.
phone.passwordGuide: The server checks length, common passwords, all-numeric passwords, and similarity to your name or email. If it rejects the password, those messages stay under the field.
phone.emailTakenHint: This email belongs to another account. A new registration does not attach that account to this number.
phone.emailAccountPath: Sign in to the email account
phone.registrationInvalidHint: This registration request cannot continue. Request a code again.
phone.resetOtpBody: A code is sent only for a verified, active, unlocked number. After the change you must sign in again.
phone.resetPasswordBody: Saving the new password does not open a session. Sign in afterwards with this number and the new password.
phone.freshCodeHint: This recovery request can no longer be used. Request a new code.
phone.importedBody: set-initial-password works only with the university email and the temporary password. Phone sign-in does not create a session for this account.
phone.importedHaveCredentials: I have the email and temporary password
phone.importedSupport: If you do not have the email or the temporary password, this screen will not invent one. Contact support or follow the account migration.
phone.desktopBrand: Soha is the assistant of Shahid Beheshti University. Sign-in and registration start with a mobile number. An older account with no phone keeps using email until migration.
phone.legacyAction: I already had an email account
phone.legacyBody: This path is only for an existing email account that has no phone yet. A university email and password do not create a new Soha account.
phone.smsRequested: The SMS request was accepted. Delivery to the handset is not guaranteed.
phone.registerWarningTitle: This number will not join an old account
phone.registerWarningBody: If you already had an email account with no phone, continuing here creates a second account. Use the email path instead.
phone.emailHint: An optional email is not verified and cannot be used for password recovery.
phone.resetDone: Password changed. Sign in again. The previous session was closed.
phone.setupBody: This account does not have a verified phone yet. There is no self-service way to attach a number to an old account. Until support or the planned migration attaches it, keep using email login.
